Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (Season of Hell's Legacy, live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). Landslide is the Druid build the owner's reference sites rate highest: d4builds A (the first Druid entry on Rob2628's 'Season 15 Endgame' list) and Maxroll push A (first Druid on the push list, where order inside a tier is meaningful); Maxroll also rates it A on endgame and speedfarm. InfinityBuilds ranks no Druid on either of its lists, and no Druid reaches S on any of the three sites. Disagreements kept visible: Maxroll's endgame list puts Lacerate and Storm Strike ahead of Landslide inside A; d4builds shows a second 'Landslide' entry in B, drawn with the Wolves icon and linking to the same page (unresolved on the site); and Maxroll's own guide has two shapes — its Starter/Midgame/Endgame profiles run a human-form Trample / Cataclysm / Hurricane / Poison Creeper bar ('Trampleslide') with The Furnace, while its Push(WIP) profile and d4builds run the Werebear Earth Spike / Grizzly Rage / Cyclone Armor bar with Azurewrath. This page follows d4builds (weighted first) at late endgame, Maxroll's Push(WIP) profile at pushing, and Maxroll's Trampleslide profiles only for the leveling and early-endgame steps — the progression Maxroll's guide itself follows. d4builds' description: Landslide 'turns it into an Werebear Skill and scales its damage with Overpower and Resolve stacks. The Linta of the Old Mountain Talisman set will constantly petrify enemies'. The 3.2.1 facts behind it: Song of the Old Mountain's 2-piece 'Damage no longer requires Earth skills' and its stop-working / chain-CC bugs are fixed; Grizzly Rage bakes Cornered Beast in at up to 150%[x]; the Willpower scalar is 1.625%; Might of the Ursine is 7–9%[x] and Werebear-only (knowledge base). Hellfire caveat (the −100% Critical Strike Chance drawback is first-party since 2026-09-20 — the game files SNO 4080 S15_Socketable_NaKrul with script formula SF_1 = 1 in the game files, local install 3.2.1.73552; its 20/30/40/50%[x] damage tier is still a data-mined value, unconfirmed; how the references' crit gear survives the drawback is unresolved): Splinter of Hellfire trades its damage for −100% Critical Strike Chance, yet d4builds and Maxroll's Endgame and Push(WIP) Landslide loadouts socket it next to Critical Strike Chance affixes and a Critical Strike Chance weapon temper. Follow the references, then check the character sheet with Hellfire socketed: if Critical Strike Chance reads 0%, treat every Critical Strike Chance affix, the Critical Strike Chance temper and Fists of Fate's crit line as dead, re-roll/re-temper toward Vulnerable Damage, Willpower, Maximum Life or Cooldown Reduction, and test Splinter of Anguish in Hellfire's place on a dummy. No crit floor is written for this build for that reason. Soul Splinters: every reference loadout sockets four to five (two in Leoric's Crown plus jewelry), and d4builds runs Splinter of Pain twice; the season article's 'up to three' cap and whether duplicates stack are unpublished — re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Toggle Lightning Storm, keep Grizzly Rage up, cast Cyclone Armor to pull the pack in, Earth Spike to keep Overpower stacks, then spam Landslide.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Hurricane up, drop Poison Creeper and Cataclysm on packs, Trample in for Unstoppable, spam Landslide.
Move on when Move to early_endgame when you own Leoric's Crown and The Basilisk and have five Old Mountain charms (the Midgame profile's three set-defining pieces).

Early Endgame — Keep Hurricane up, drop Poison Creeper and Cataclysm on packs, Trample in for Unstoppable, spam Landslide.
Move on when Respec to the Werebear bar when you hold The Basilisk, Ring of Starless Skies, Tibault's Will and 5 Old Mountain charms plus Azurewrath, and have Overcharged Aspect available to transfigure onto your amulet — d4builds' listed requirements (Linta of the Old Mountain set, Que + Tibault's Will, The Basilisk, Ring of Starless Skies, Overcharged Aspect transfigured on amulet).

Late Endgame — Toggle Lightning Storm. Maintain Grizzly Rage. Cast Cyclone Armor to pull enemies in. Cast Earth Spike to maintain Overpower stacks. Spam Landslide. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)
Move on when Push when every mythic is Ancestral-rolled and you have Azurewrath as the sixth charm; swap Fractured Runestone for Might of the Ursine and move Anguish to the ring when you enter the Maxroll push layout.

Pushing — Toggle Lightning Storm. Maintain Grizzly Rage. Cast Cyclone Armor to pull enemies in. Cast Earth Spike to maintain Overpower stacks. Spam Landslide. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)

Board & glyph focus

Maxroll Starter route (planner 4oygc0ib, Step 1, glyphs level 1): Start (Earth and Sky) → Ancestral Guidance (Dominate) → Survival Instincts (Fang and Claw) → Constricting Tendrils (Werebear) → Earthen Devastation (Headhunter); the guide's board-rush step runs Start with Headhunter first. Spirit Boons (Starter profile): Gift of the Stag, Calamity, Energize (Wolf), Obsidian Slam (Snake), Swooping Attacks (Eagle). Talisman at this step: Fer, Berú and Linta of the Den Mother plus one blank charm, Rare Horadric Seal.

Board & glyph focus

Maxroll 'Step 3: Endgame (Lvl. 100 Glyphs)', the step matching this gear: Start (Earth and Sky) → Ancestral Guidance (Dominate) → Survival Instincts (Fang and Claw) → Constricting Tendrils (Spirit) → Earthen Devastation (Headhunter). Step 2 'Midgame' is the same order at glyph level 50. Spirit Boons (Midgame profile): Gift of the Stag, Avian Wrath, Calamity, Obsidian Slam, Scythe Talons. Talisman at this step: the five Old Mountain charms, no sixth, Legendary Horadric Seal. Hellfire caveat (the −100% Critical Strike Chance drawback is first-party since 2026-09-20 — the game files SNO 4080 S15_Socketable_NaKrul with script formula SF_1 = 1 in the game files, local install 3.2.1.73552; its 20/30/40/50%[x] damage tier is still a data-mined value, unconfirmed; how the references' crit gear survives the drawback is unresolved): Splinter of Hellfire trades its damage for −100% Critical Strike Chance, yet d4builds and Maxroll's Endgame and Push(WIP) Landslide loadouts socket it next to Critical Strike Chance affixes and a Critical Strike Chance weapon temper. Follow the references, then check the character sheet with Hellfire socketed: if Critical Strike Chance reads 0%, treat every Critical Strike Chance affix, the Critical Strike Chance temper and Fists of Fate's crit line as dead, re-roll/re-temper toward Vulnerable Damage, Willpower, Maximum Life or Cooldown Reduction, and test Splinter of Anguish in Hellfire's place on a dummy. No crit floor is written for this build for that reason.

Board & glyph focus

Maxroll 'Step 4: Push', glyph level 150: Start (Dominate) → Ancestral Guidance (Outmatch) → Survival Instincts (Earth and Sky) → Constricting Tendrils (Spirit) → Earthen Devastation (Fang and Claw). Spirit Boons: Avian Wrath, Calamity, Calm Before the Storm, Obsidian Slam, Gift of the Stag. Maxroll labels this profile work in progress. Hellfire caveat (the −100% Critical Strike Chance drawback is first-party since 2026-09-20 — the game files SNO 4080 S15_Socketable_NaKrul with script formula SF_1 = 1 in the game files, local install 3.2.1.73552; its 20/30/40/50%[x] damage tier is still a data-mined value, unconfirmed; how the references' crit gear survives the drawback is unresolved): Splinter of Hellfire trades its damage for −100% Critical Strike Chance, yet d4builds and Maxroll's Endgame and Push(WIP) Landslide loadouts socket it next to Critical Strike Chance affixes and a Critical Strike Chance weapon temper. Follow the references, then check the character sheet with Hellfire socketed: if Critical Strike Chance reads 0%, treat every Critical Strike Chance affix, the Critical Strike Chance temper and Fists of Fate's crit line as dead, re-roll/re-temper toward Vulnerable Damage, Willpower, Maximum Life or Cooldown Reduction, and test Splinter of Anguish in Hellfire's place on a dummy. No crit floor is written for this build for that reason.

How to run them

d4builds (2026-09-16): hire Raheir, The Shieldbearer, reinforce with Varyana casting Bloodthirst on Landslide. Maxroll Push(WIP) is identical (Varyana Bloodthirst, trigger Landslide). Maxroll's Starter, Midgame and Endgame profiles instead hire Subo with Raheir reinforcing on Bastion when injured — the leveling-step pairing. Hired-mercenary skill picks are unpublished by d4builds and the planner's mercenary picks could not be matched reliably, so no skills are listed.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (Season of Hell's Legacy, live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). Landslide is the Druid build the owner's reference sites rate highest: d4builds A (the first Druid entry on Rob2628's 'Season 15 Endgame' list) and Maxroll push A (first Druid on the push list, where order inside a tier is meaningful); Maxroll also rates it A on endgame and speedfarm. InfinityBuilds ranks no Druid on either of its lists, and no Druid reaches S on any of the three sites. Disagreements kept visible: Maxroll's endgame list puts Lacerate and Storm Strike ahead of Landslide inside A; d4builds shows a second 'Landslide' entry in B, drawn with the Wolves icon and linking to the same page (unresolved on the site); and Maxroll's own guide has two shapes — its Starter/Midgame/Endgame profiles run a human-form Trample / Cataclysm / Hurricane / Poison Creeper bar ('Trampleslide') with The Furnace, while its Push(WIP) profile and d4builds run the Werebear Earth Spike / Grizzly Rage / Cyclone Armor bar with Azurewrath. This page follows d4builds (weighted first) at late endgame, Maxroll's Push(WIP) profile at pushing, and Maxroll's Trampleslide profiles only for the leveling and early-endgame steps — the progression Maxroll's guide itself follows. d4builds' description: Landslide 'turns it into an Werebear Skill and scales its damage with Overpower and Resolve stacks. The Linta of the Old Mountain Talisman set will constantly petrify enemies'. The 3.2.1 facts behind it: Song of the Old Mountain's 2-piece 'Damage no longer requires Earth skills' and its stop-working / chain-CC bugs are fixed; Grizzly Rage bakes Cornered Beast in at up to 150%[x]; the Willpower scalar is 1.625%; Might of the Ursine is 7–9%[x] and Werebear-only (knowledge base). Hellfire caveat (the −100% Critical Strike Chance drawback is first-party since 2026-09-20 — the game files SNO 4080 S15_Socketable_NaKrul with script formula SF_1 = 1 in the game files, local install 3.2.1.73552; its 20/30/40/50%[x] damage tier is still a data-mined value, unconfirmed; how the references' crit gear survives the drawback is unresolved): Splinter of Hellfire trades its damage for −100% Critical Strike Chance, yet d4builds and Maxroll's Endgame and Push(WIP) Landslide loadouts socket it next to Critical Strike Chance affixes and a Critical Strike Chance weapon temper. Follow the references, then check the character sheet with Hellfire socketed: if Critical Strike Chance reads 0%, treat every Critical Strike Chance affix, the Critical Strike Chance temper and Fists of Fate's crit line as dead, re-roll/re-temper toward Vulnerable Damage, Willpower, Maximum Life or Cooldown Reduction, and test Splinter of Anguish in Hellfire's place on a dummy. No crit floor is written for this build for that reason. Soul Splinters: every reference loadout sockets four to five (two in Leoric's Crown plus jewelry), and d4builds runs Splinter of Pain twice; the season article's 'up to three' cap and whether duplicates stack are unpublished — re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Toggle Lightning Storm, keep Grizzly Rage up, cast Cyclone Armor to pull the pack in, Earth Spike to keep Overpower stacks, then spam Landslide.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Hurricane up, drop Poison Creeper and Cataclysm on packs, Trample in for Unstoppable, spam Landslide.
Move on when Move to early_endgame when you own Leoric's Crown and The Basilisk and have five Old Mountain charms (the Midgame profile's three set-defining pieces).

Early Endgame — Keep Hurricane up, drop Poison Creeper and Cataclysm on packs, Trample in for Unstoppable, spam Landslide.
Move on when Respec to the Werebear bar when you hold The Basilisk, Ring of Starless Skies, Tibault's Will and 5 Old Mountain charms plus Azurewrath, and have Overcharged Aspect available to transfigure onto your amulet — d4builds' listed requirements (Linta of the Old Mountain set, Que + Tibault's Will, The Basilisk, Ring of Starless Skies, Overcharged Aspect transfigured on amulet).

Late Endgame — Toggle Lightning Storm. Maintain Grizzly Rage. Cast Cyclone Armor to pull enemies in. Cast Earth Spike to maintain Overpower stacks. Spam Landslide. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)
Move on when Push when every mythic is Ancestral-rolled and you have Azurewrath as the sixth charm; swap Fractured Runestone for Might of the Ursine and move Anguish to the ring when you enter the Maxroll push layout.

Pushing — Toggle Lightning Storm. Maintain Grizzly Rage. Cast Cyclone Armor to pull enemies in. Cast Earth Spike to maintain Overpower stacks. Spam Landslide. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)

Provoke

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Shield Charge

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.

Crater

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst deals 40% more Physical damage and additionally Stuns enemies for 2 secondseconds.

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15%[+] Armor.

PassiveRaheir

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Sundering Shield

PassiveRaheir

Shield Throw

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.

Iron Wolf's Arrival

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw.

Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Consecrated Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.

Bastion

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 30 seconds

Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds.

Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1.0 secondseconds.
